_about: Single source of truth for timing. animation.py (cameras, events, captions, titles) and tools/voiceover.py read this file. Times are seconds from the start of the video at 30 fps.

scenes.name: THE HOOK
scenes.desc: Night aerial over a foggy, late-1960s San Francisco; the camera sinks to a dark street where a figure stands far off, face unseen.

scenes.name: THE BEGINNING
scenes.desc: A 1960s street at night: period cars, streetlights, a newspaper stand; a police car rolls past with its red light turning.

scenes.name: THE LETTERS
scenes.desc: A police investigation room; a letter slides across the desk; close-up of the handwriting, the crossed-circle symbol and lines of code.

scenes.name: THE CIPHERS
scenes.desc: The 408-symbol cipher in three parts and its 1969 solution; the 340-symbol cipher assembling in the dark, 51 years, and its 2020 decoding; the investigation board and timeline.

scenes.name: THE INVESTIGATION
scenes.desc: Evidence on the desk: map of the attack sites, fingerprint card, letters, case files; location photographs and notes on the wall.

scenes.name: THE FINAL REVEAL
scenes.desc: The room's lights go out one by one; the camera pushes toward the Zodiac symbol; IDENTITY UNKNOWN; fade to black.

lines.text: One of America's most mysterious killers sent coded messages to newspapers, challenged police, and disappeared without ever being conclusively identified.
lines.tts: One of America's most mysterious killers sent coded messages to newspapers, challenged police, and disappeared without ever being conclusively identified.

lines.text: In 1968 and '69, five people were killed. Two more survived.
lines.tts: In nineteen sixty-eight and sixty-nine, five people were killed. Two more survived.

lines.text: Then came the letters, from someone calling himself the Zodiac.
lines.tts: Then came the letters, from someone calling himself the Zodiac.

lines.text: They were signed with a strange crossed-circle symbol. And some were written in code.
lines.tts: They were signed with a strange crossed-circle symbol. And some were written in code.

lines.text: A schoolteacher and his wife cracked the first cipher within a week. It gave no name.
lines.tts: A schoolteacher and his wife cracked the first cipher within a week. It gave no name.

lines.text: But a second cipher, 340 symbols long, stayed unsolved for 51 years, until codebreakers cracked it in 2020.
lines.tts: But a second cipher, three hundred and forty symbols long, stayed unsolved for fifty-one years, until codebreakers cracked it in twenty twenty.

lines.text: It mocked the police, but revealed nothing about who wrote it.
lines.tts: It mocked the police, but revealed nothing about who wrote it.

lines.text: Detectives compared handwriting, fingerprints, and later DNA. Suspects were investigated. No one was ever charged.
lines.tts: Detectives compared handwriting, fingerprints, and later DNA. Suspects were investigated. No one was ever charged.

lines.text: Decades later, the Zodiac Killer's identity remains unknown. And one of America's most infamous mysteries is still unsolved.
lines.tts: Decades later, the Zodiac Killer's identity remains unknown. And one of America's most infamous mysteries is still unsolved.

titles.text: RECREATION: HANDWRITING AND CIPHER SYMBOLS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE
THE ZODIAC CASE IS STILL UNSOLVED
